meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so let's use them. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
You're clearly a brilliant lawyer, and I really respect how hard you fight for Owen.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
Can you step out of the role and tell me how I should handle this?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? Withdraw the zero. Then tell me who decided on it and whether Owen was spoken to first.
I just want us to be on the same team here.
Then why are we here, Hale? Nobody called me before that zero went in, and Owen found out from his phone in the middle of class. What do you have besides the checker?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn and that you tell me in writing who decided it and whether Owen was spoken to first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed and her next step still the principal.
What moved her: nothing, since you never gave her a document or answered her question about who decided the zero.
What cost ground: "tell me how I should handle this", because asking her to do your job cost you her respect and gave her nothing to weigh.
Try next time: when she first asks who decided and whether Owen was spoken to, answer in one sentence, own that the zero went in before you called home, and then put a dated document in front of her.
